title: Perfect 10 Magazine Fall 1998 Collectors Contest Issue Model Search Baywatch
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue in nice shape for its age. Glossy cover is bright with light corner and edge wear and minor scuffing along the spine edges. Spine intact. No mailing label. Interior not page-checked - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Perfect 10 Magazine, Fall 1998 issue - the Special Collector's Contest Issue. Cover price $6.95.

A first-year issue of Norm Zada's "The Connoisseur's Magazine", the all-natural title built on its no-cosmetic-surgery premise and printed on heavy glossy stock.

Cover lines:
- Top Finalists in the $500,000 Model Search
- Greg Bonann: The Man Behind Baywatch
- Interview with Felix Cavaliere of the Rascals
- Charles Fleischer on the Computer Mouse

Gold cover with the feather-boa cover model and three finalist portraits along the bottom. The back cover carries a 1998 Courvoisier cognac ad, "Welcome to the State of Courvoisier" - the black-and-white stone heads in the water. The spine reads "Fall 98".

Condition: pre-owned with light handling wear; see the photos and condition note.
